english.meaning: a group of people traveling together on a tour
english.note: 跟團 means join a group tour.

exampleSentences.english: Oh, if you join a tour, they probably just go to tourist spots.
exampleSentences.traditional: 哦你跟團可能佢就係去啲旅遊點囖。

exampleSentences.english: But tickets are really hard to get, aren’t they? And how are you going—on your own or with a tour group?
exampleSentences.traditional: 但係好難買飛喎係唔係啊？同埋點樣啊？自己去定跟團去唧？
